findings.description: Occurrence of '.advanced-.advanced-plans' string is inside the loop-036 handoff_summary.failed narrative — it is the documented evidence of the now-fixed attempt-1 corruption, not a live path reference. Confirmed not functional.
findings.evidence: grep -n '.advanced-.advanced-plans' .advanced-plans/phases/phase-9/loops.md returns line 526 only, within a 'failed:' YAML string value

findings.description: Frontmatter field 'design_spec: plans/2026-05-14-advanced-plans-restructure-design.md' references the old pre-migration path, which no longer exists. The file is now at '.advanced-plans/specs/2026-05-14-advanced-plans-restructure-design.md'. This is a stale metadata reference in an internal plan artefact; it does not affect any command's runtime behaviour.

setup/claude-code/README.md still documents the old layout: it shows 'plans/' as the planning data home, references '.claude/state/', shows old post-loop project layout, and describes '/run-gate' writing verdicts to 'plans/gate-verdicts/'. This is user-facing install documentation that would mislead a new adopter about where planning data lives.
findings.evidence: grep -n 'plans/' setup/claude-code/README.md returns 6 matches showing old layout at lines 74, 123, 201, 217, 280. setup/claude-code/ was not in the audit scope of the grep audit (which covered core/, platforms/, CLAUDE.md, SKILL.md files); this file was missed.

findings.description: An empty directory '.claude/plans/' exists on disk (not tracked by git). It is an untracked filesystem artefact from the old layout, likely a remnant pre-migration. Since git ls-files returns nothing for it and it is empty, it has no functional impact.
findings.evidence: ls -la .claude/plans/ shows total 4 (. and .. only); git ls-files .claude/plans/ returns empty

findings.description: The idempotent migration block in install.sh uses 'cp -R $PROJECT_DIR/plans/.' when it detects a legacy layout. This is intentional — the old path is being READ as the migration source, not written as a new home. The logic is correct and safe.
findings.evidence: Context at line 198-200: 'if [ -d $PROJECT_DIR/plans ] && [ ! -f $AP_DIR/PLANS-INDEX.md ]' guards the copy; copy direction is plans/ → .advanced-plans/

findings.description: plan_io.py retains a 'flat legacy fallback' code path that accepts 'plans/' as a phases_dir argument. This is an intentional backward-compatibility shim documented in the docstring, not a live path reference. Zero-dependency invariant confirmed clean by AST checker.
findings.evidence: grep -n 'plans/' platforms/python/plan_io.py shows only docstring references to the legacy layout; AST checker: NONE
